handback.title: Dokima's own problems file themselves into Dokima's repo
handback.summary: Problems that are Dokima's fault, and failed runs, on a trial repo file themselves into Dokima's repo.
handback.user_story: When Dokima misbehaves on another repo, the owner finds one issue for it in Dokima's repo, linking back.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the settings name no upstream repo, a problem tagged as Dokima's fault is filed in the repo itself.
acceptance_criteria.words: default: none, so an adopter's issues stay local
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One fixed default; the untagged case is filed under criterion 2.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the settings name an upstream repo, a problem tagged as Dokima's fault is filed there.

edge_cases.case: An untagged problem in the same review stays in the repo itself.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a problem is filed upstream, it links back to the issue where it was seen.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One link on one filing; repeats are criterion 5.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every agent's instructions show the tag that marks a problem as Dokima's fault.
acceptance_criteria.words: gains a tag agents put on problems that are Dokima's fault, not the repo's
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Fixed prompt text, checked for every role.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the same tagged problem is raised again, it becomes a comment on the upstream issue, never a second issue.
acceptance_criteria.words: Repeats become comments on the existing upstream issue, never a second issue.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A first filing is proved by criterion 2.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a shared workflow's job fails, the upstream repo gets an issue linking the failed run.
acceptance_criteria.words: files the failure upstream with the run link

edge_cases.case: With no upstream repo set, a failure files nothing and the step passes.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every job of each shared workflow ends with a step that files its failure upstream.
acceptance_criteria.words: A final step in each shared workflow
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Every job of every shared workflow is checked.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the same failure happens twice, the upstream repo holds one issue with two comments, each linking its run.
acceptance_criteria.words: forcing the same Dokima-caused failure twice on the trial repo yields one upstream issue with two linked comments

edge_cases.case: A different job's failure opens its own upstream issue.

non_functional.text: Filing upstream mints its key from the App's existing key, with no new secret.
non_functional.why: The App's key already covers every repo it is installed on.

raises.label: Failed test checks
raises.text: Should failed test checks also file upstream? They usually fail on the repo's code, not Dokima's. The plan assumes yes.
raises.evidence: `entry.yml` calls `full-suite.yml` and `acceptance-criteria.yml`, which run the repo's tests; the plan covers every shared workflow.

raises.label: First failure comments
raises.text: Should the first failure also post a comment, so two failures give two linked comments? The plan assumes it does.
raises.evidence: The issue's Done when asks for one upstream issue with two linked comments after two failures.
